description: This file defines a 'Coverage' class that provides coverage information for providers, commands, command models, and references in a trading platform application. It includes properties to access provider coverage, command coverage, command-to-model mappings, and reference data, as well as a method to retrieve command schema routes.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: A class providing methods and properties to access coverage and reference data related to commands and providers in the application.

methods.name: __init__(self, app: "BaseApp")
methods.description: Initializes the Coverage object with the app instance and sets up command, provider, and reference loaders.

methods.name: str __repr__(self)
methods.description: Returns the docstring of the class.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[str]] providers(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a dictionary mapping provider names to their coverage details.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[str]] commands(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a dictionary mapping command names to their coverage details.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]]]] command_model(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a nested dictionary mapping commands to their associated models.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict] reference(self)
methods.description: Property that returns reference data loaded by ReferenceLoader.

methods.name: command_schemas(self, filter_by_provider: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Method that returns route schemas for commands, optionally filtered by provider.

ctags.name: command_model
ctags.pattern: /^    def command_model(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]]]:$/
